I will be joining **BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus** as an **Assistant Professor** in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, starting **Jan 29, 2026**.

Prior to this, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher at **Universidad de Lisboa**, and formerly at TIFR and CMI. My research focuses on theoretical computer science, specifically Circuit Complexity, Communication & Query Complexity, Analysis of Boolean Functions, and Data Structures.

This website is a collection of my academic work, coding projects, and personal learnings. I aim to present complex ideas with clarity and elegance.
